 (Shri Rampal Uikey,Counsel For The Objector)
 Order

1. This is applicant's first application under Section 842 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (Section 438 of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973) for grant of anticipatory bail, as he is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No.567/2024 registered at Police Station Kishanganj, District Indore (MP) for offence punishable under Section 376(2)(n) of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2. Allegations against the applicant is of rape on the prosecutrix.

3. Counsel for the applicant has submitted that the prosecutrix was a consenting party and infact they have already solemnized marriage on 06/07/2024 in the presence of family members of the applicant and prosecutrix.
Hence, it is submitted that the application be allowed and he be released on anticipatory bail as his custodial interrogation is not necessary.
4. Counsel for the complainant has also submitted that the prosecutrix is also present in the Court and he has no objection if the bail application is allowed.
On a query, made by this Court to the prosecutrix, she has also submitted that she has no objection is the applicant is granted anticipatory bail as they both have solemnized marriage.
6. Counsel for the respondent /
State , on the other hand, has opposed the prayer.

sentences.text: 7. On due consideration of the rival submissions and perusal of the case diary as also the documents filed on record including the marriage certificate and the photographs of the marriage of applicant with prosecutrix, this Court is of the considered opinion that under the facts and circumstances of the case, the custodial interrogation of the applicant is not necessary in the present case.

In view of the same, applicant has made out a case for grant of anticipatory bail.
8.
Accordingly, this application is allowed.

It is directed that in the event of arrest, applicant shall be released on bail, upon his executing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (rupees twenty five thousand only) and furnishing one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer (Investigating Officer).
9.
The applicant shall make himself available for interrogation by a Police Officer, as and when required.
He shall further abide by the other conditions enumerated in Sub Section (2) of Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.
Certified copy as per rules.
